document: Senior Fullstack Developer at SiteDrive (August 2017 - July 2018). SiteDrive is a construction management platform for site managers and workers. Built Java/Spring backend with GraphQL middleware. Developed React and React Native clients for web and mobile. Delivered end-to-end features across backend and frontend. Ensured scalable, maintainable, and user-friendly cross-platform solutions.
